competency questions can be used as an input for ontology authoring, and the requirements for an ontologist to author a good ontology are: (1) to understand the competency questions and the ontology requirements they imply; (2) to author an ontology that satisfies these requirements; (3) to test whether the ontology indeed satisfies these requirements.
